name: ledgerline
description: Ledgerline - multi-organisation double-entry accounting platform (Phases 1-8: accounting core)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
